subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They also saw volunteers recording bird numbers every year.”?
options: It helped them understand movement, control, and change.
Small changes can grow, and data is never complete.
Showing how data is collected helps people understand why it can be trusted.
The data helped scientists understand changes in migration.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It helped them understand movement, control, and change.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Small changes can grow, and data is never complete.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Showing how data is collected helps people understand why it can be trusted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They also saw volunteers recording bird numbers every year. The data helped scientists understand changes in migration.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
